description: Set a breakpoint on a function you can name, without knowing which file it lives in. Give any expression that evaluates to a function — 'app.saveOrder', 'MyClass.prototype.load', a framework helper — and DevCDP finds its definition and breaks at its first statement. Use this when you know what runs but not where it is defined; use debugger_set_breakpoint when you already have a file and line.

auto_resume.description: Default true: capture scope/console/network on hit, then resume, so the page is never left frozen and the action that tripped it completes. Pass false to hold the pause for stepping; released after maxPauseMs regardless.

condition.description: JavaScript condition — pause only when it is truthy, e.g. 'id === 42'.

function_expression.description: JavaScript evaluating to the function itself — no call parentheses. For example 'app.store.save', not 'app.store.save()'.

name: debugger_set_breakpoint_at_function
